title: HtmlForm
responsibility: Renders the native form element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlForm.attributes
inputs.description: Native form attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlForm.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native form element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlForm
outputs.description: The actual native form element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
